text:
Nina (Partnerships): quick sync for Harrow Labs EAP. NDA executed this morning. Key asks: benchmark matrix, telemetry floor & redlines, lab sloting for long runs, and marketplace naming/embargo. Keep replies short.

Victor (Eng-ML): propose matrix: batches [1,8,32], seq [64,256,1024], models: rwd-gpt-1.5b, community-8b-q4. Metrics: p50/p95 latency, sustained tokens/sec, memory per-GPU, power draw, and a 200-sample quality sanity check. I'll own the ML runs.

Rosa (Infra): staging harness at gs://redwood-eap/harrow/harness-v1.tar.gz. Need partner SSH key and route to 10.20.30.0/24. Harrow boards ship with thermal governor that steps down after 90m; partner offered a firmware toggle. If we need 4+ hour soak tests, we'll coordinate firmware update Friday.

Jules (Legal): Harrow asked for 1h telemetry granularity; we prefer 24h aggregates and explicit ban on storing raw request payloads or user identifiers. I'll post a one-paragraph NDA amendment. Also: partner wants a usage dashboard export; we should offer aggregated CSV only.

Ari (Product): marketplace draft in drive. They requested a co-branded hero image and the tag "Harrow-Accelerated". Marketing likes the tag; legal likely will push for "Harrow-Validated". Also need to align on embargo: partner proposes 1 week post-baseline; we prefer 2-3 weeks to absorb any regressions.

Victor (Eng-ML): small run snippet for steady-state measurement (will add to CI ticket):

```bash
# steady-state warmup + measure
python perf.py --model rwd-gpt-1.5b --seq 1024 --batch 8 --warmup 500 --iters 2000 --log gs://redwood-eap/harrow/results/run-001.log
```

Rosa (Infra): I'll provision bastion rules and post scheduled lab slots: Mon/Wed next week 09:00-17:00 PT. Mark Friday open for firmware window if partner sends patch.

Jules (Legal): uploaded NDA amendment: "Allowed telemetry: aggregated tokens/sec, per-run p50/p95, GPU temp (avg/max), power draw. Prohibited: raw request payloads, user identifiers, or traceable UUIDs. Aggregation window: 24h." Please review.

dock-bot: perf job created: hrw-007 (owner: Rosa). CI: https://ci.redwood/runs/hrw-007

Nina (Partnerships): owners recap: Victor (runs + prompts), Rosa (infra + lab), Jules (legal redline), Ari (marketplace + comms). Timeline: baseline runs by +6d, firmware window +8d, NDA finalize in 48h, marketplace copy freeze in 9d. Target joint announcement 2 weeks after stable baseline. React with :white_check_mark: to confirm.

Victor (Eng-ML): :white_check_mark: will drop prompt set (200) in drive and kick runs Thu AM.

Rosa (Infra): :white_check_mark: provisioning and booking slots now.

Jules (Legal): :white_check_mark: will email partner counsel after final review.

Ari (Product): :white_check_mark: looping in comms and design for co-branded assets.

Nina (Partnerships): thanks all 60a keeping thread as audit. If partner insists on hourly telemetry, offer a secure dashboard view instead of raw exports. Ping me for blockers.
